newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile October retail sales grow four pct from 1995.
newsitem.headline: Chile October retail sales grow four pct from 1995.

text.p: Chilean retail sales grew four percent last month compared with October 1995, said the National Chamber of Commerce.
The figure showed sales growth was stronger in October than in September, when sales increased 1.9 percent.
October's data bring the rise in sales in the first 10 months of the year to 5.8 percent.
Areas which reported greatest sales growth included footware, up 13 percent, and clothing sales, which rose 12 percent from October 1995.
